source.author: verg
source.text: Tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus Aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
source.text_original: Tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus Aether / coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis / magnus alit magno commixtus corpore fetus.
source.text_english: Then the all-powerful Father Aether descends with fruitful showers into the bosom of his joyful consort, and, mingled in one great body, nourishes all the life-giving offspring.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: Cleanthes et Anaximenes aethera esse dicunt summum deum, cui opinioni poeta noster assensit: tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno permixtus corpore fetus.
reuse.text_original: Cleanthes et Anaximenes aethera esse dicunt summum deum, cui opinioni poeta noster assensit: tum pater omnipotens fecundis imbribus aether coniugis in gremium laetae descendit et omnis magnus alit magno permixtus corpore fetus.
reuse.text_english: Cleanthes and Anaximenes say that the ether is the supreme god, to whose opinion our poet agreed: then the all-powerful father, ether, descends with fruitful rains into the lap of his joyful consort, and, mingled with her great body, nourishes all offspring.
